history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young person wearing a black hooded jacket and black track pants with white stripes stands on a stone path in a lush, green forest. They are looking off to the right, their back mostly to the viewer. To their left, a series of moss-covered stone steps ascend into the dense foliage. A weathered wooden railing runs along the right side of the path, separating it from more vibrant green undergrowth.

Dominating the background is a large, dark green sign with white text. The sign is partially obscured by ferns and other tropical plants. The text on the sign, in Indonesian, discusses "Cibeureum Selabintana," detailing its meaning and the origin of its name, referencing a waterfall that is 60 meters high and a unique moss called *Sphagnum gedeanum* endemic to Gede Pangrango.

The overall lighting is dappled, suggesting a cloudy day or a dense forest canopy, with pockets of light illuminating the vibrant greens of the leaves. The color palette is rich with various shades of green, from the deep, dark greens of the background foliage to the brighter, lighter greens of the foreground plants. The stone path and railing add earthy tones of grey and brown. The mood is serene and natural, with a sense of exploration and discovery. The style is photorealistic, capturing the details of the natural environment and the textures of the plants, stone, and wood. The composition frames the young person against the backdrop of the natural landscape and informative sign.
